outline.rationale: The user is new to both concepts but building a real product, so the outline front-loads two concept nodes (RAG, fine-tuning) explained from scratch, then immediately pivots to a comparison node clarifying which problem each solves — the core mental model. The middle nodes (data, cost/maintenance, accuracy/latency/control) are the concrete decision factors flagged in the confirmed understanding, kept MECE: data characteristics, economics, and quality/performance are distinct axes with low overlap. The decision checklist synthesizes these into actionable guidance for their specific feature. The final node gives a pragmatic default recommendation since RAG is typically the right starting point for new builders, which is more useful than neutral fence-sitting. Math, implementation internals, and hybrid setups are excluded per the user's stated priorities. No intro/conclusion filler.
